anchor: The entire pipeline is CPU-only and deterministic given a trace window.
claim_text: Pipeline is CPU-only and deterministic for a given trace window.

anchor: Dispatch is greedy FIFO: a freed worker takes whole queued requests, in order, up to a 64-image cap (the collected batch range, so no extrapolation); a request exceeding the cap alone (the trace reaches 97^2 = 9409 images) is chunked into ≤64-image forwards that enter the FIFO as independent units, so several free workers drain one oversized request concurrently.
claim_text: Greedy FIFO dispatch with 64-image cap; oversized requests (up to 9409 images) chunked into ≤64-image units processed concurrently.

anchor: Chunk-parallel dispatch is a simulator policy assumption: consistent with encoder-disaggregated runtimes that route image groups independently across encoder instances, physically grounded (images are independent in the encoder), but not a property of the trace.
claim_text: Chunk-parallel dispatch is a simulator policy assumption, not a trace property.

anchor: Second, the bound is bandwidth-only: contention, serialization points, NIC/PCIe placement, and cross-node topology are not modeled, so it is a lower bound on transfer latency, not a tail estimate; it is charged to request latency but not to the worker (asynchronous DMA/NIC), optimistic for encoder throughput, and a measured NIXL curve can later replace it.
claim_text: Handoff bound is bandwidth-only lower bound, not a tail estimate; charged to request latency not worker; optimistic for encoder throughput.

anchor: The language pool must hold TTFT p99 < 1 second and inter-token latency (ITL) p99 < 100 ms; the vision pool must hold encoder delay p99 < 1 second, matching the language TTFT budget.
claim_text: Evaluation SLA: language pool TTFT p99 < 1s, ITL p99 < 100ms; vision pool encoder delay p99 < 1s.

anchor: This encoder percentile is taken over all requests --- a text-only request incurs zero encoder delay, so it is a user-population tail, not a vision-pool-conditional one; the stage-conditional (image-bearing) variant is reported alongside it where the distinction matters.
claim_text: Encoder delay p99 computed over all requests (including text-only with zero delay), not conditional on image-bearing requests.

anchor: The specific bounds double Dynamo's default planner targets (500/50 ms, window-mean) applied as tail bounds, consistent with common practice in disaggregated-serving evaluations.
claim_text: Evaluation SLA bounds double Dynamo's default planner targets (500ms/50ms window-mean) as tail bounds.

anchor: All encoder timing derives from a single RTX 5090 node (locked clocks); cross-unit silicon variance is unquantified.
claim_text: Encoder timing from single RTX 5090 node (locked clocks); cross-unit variance unquantified.
